gates.description: Eligible onboarding completion is at least 75% in beta.
First-session first-log rate is at least 65%.
p75 standard logging time is at most 20 seconds on the supported device matrix.
Age, targets, BMI, local day, streak, freeze, pause, notification, copy, and mascot policies pass.
Support is reachable in two taps and every regional resource is manually verified current.
Crash-free internal sessions are at least 99.8% for two consecutive weekly cohorts.
Accepted entry persistence and exactly-once sync are at least 99.95%.
Export, restore, migration, account deletion, backup, and restore rehearsals succeed in a production-like environment.
Hosted browser and production-path suites pass on the supported matrix.
Current and older supported phones pass launch, camera, keyboard, haptic, notification, background, and deep-link checks.
WCAG 2.2 AA primary web flows and VoiceOver, TalkBack, keyboard, zoom, large text, contrast, and reduced motion pass.
ASVS/MASVS evidence and independent auth, authorization, upload, AI, and deletion review have no unresolved high findings.
Deployed storage, analytics, photo, AI, export, retention, and deletion behavior matches approved disclosures.
Every deployed Neon environment is migrated and historical rows are audited for BYOK material.
Rollback, incident ownership, support escalation, backups, restore, status communication, and on-call contacts are exercised.
Dashboards and actionable alerts cover auth, API, sync, AI, notifications, crash rate, and migrations.
